Le géant des télécoms Ooredoo Algérie, s: The telecom giant Ooredoo Algeria, a major sponsor of the event, is strengthening its involvement in Algerian sports by supporting the 3rd edition of the Algiers Sports Festival, held from June 18 to 20, 2026. An event celebrating inclusion, sustainable development, and the emergence of local talent.
Alger, 19 juin 2026 – Fidèle à sa straté: Algiers, June 19, 2026 – True to its strategy of civic engagement and the promotion of sport as a lever for social development, Ooredoo Algeria has confirmed its role as a major sponsor of the 3rd edition of the Algiers Sports Festival, taking place from June 18 to 20, 2026. This event, organized under the patronage of the Ministry of Interior, Local Authorities and Transport, and under the aegis of the Wilaya of Algiers, has now established itself as a must-attend gathering for sports fans and Algiers families alike.
Un événement fédérateur sous haute patro: A unifying event under high patronage
Le coup d’envoi de cette manifestation a: The kick-off of this event was given in the presence of a high-level ministerial and institutional delegation, notably composed of:
M. Abdenour Rabehi, ministre et wali d’A: Mr. Abdenour Rabehi, Minister and Wali of Algiers;
M. Mohamed Seddik Aït Messaoudene, minis: Mr. Mohamed Seddik Aït Messaoudene, Minister of Health;
Mme Soraya Mouloudji, ministre de la Sol: Mrs. Soraya Mouloudji, Minister of National Solidarity, Family and the Status of Women;
M. Roni Tohme, Directeur général d’Oored: Mr. Roni Tohme, CEO of Ooredoo Algeria.
Cette édition, qui se tient sur 14 sites: This edition, held across 14 iconic sites in Algiers, offers over 160 sports activities accessible to all, reflecting the values of inclusion, citizenship, and sustainable development. An approach that is in perfect harmony with the societal commitments of the Ooredoo group, already known for its initiatives in favor of education, health, and technological innovation in Algeria.
Ooredoo Algérie : un acteur clé du sport: Ooredoo Algeria: a key player in national sports
Après avoir soutenu avec succès les édit: After having successfully supported previous editions, Ooredoo Algeria is renewing its partnership for this 3rd edition, thus reaffirming its role as a corporate citizen. This support is part of a global approach to promoting sport as a tool for social cohesion and the fulfillment of Algerian talent.
\" Ce festival est bien plus qu’un événe: "This festival is much more than a sporting event: it is a platform that brings the people of Algiers together around shared values, while showcasing our urban and natural heritage. As a major telecom player in Algeria, we are committed to contributing to initiatives that strengthen social ties and encourage sports practice for all," stated Mr. Roni Tohme, CEO of Ooredoo Algeria.
Un engagement aligné sur les enjeux soci: An engagement aligned with Algerian societal challenges
Le partenariat entre Ooredoo et le Festi: The partnership between Ooredoo and the Algiers Sports Festival takes place in a context where sport is increasingly recognized as a lever for human and economic development. In Algeria, telecom operators play a key role in the digitalization of public and private services, and Ooredoo is no exception. This festival, which relies on accessibility and innovation, offers an ideal showcase for promoting technological solutions serving the general public.
Par ailleurs, cette implication s’ajoute: Furthermore, this involvement adds to the group's other initiatives, such as its support for sports federations or its corporate social responsibility (CSR) programs, which aim to reduce the digital divide and encourage local entrepreneurship.
Perspectives : vers une 4ème édition enc: Outlook: towards an even more ambitious 4th edition?
Avec un public toujours plus large et un: With an ever-growing audience and an enriched program, the Algiers Sports Festival could well become a model for other wilayas. Ooredoo, as a historical partner, could play an even more central role in future editions, notably by integrating digital solutions to improve the participants' experience (online reservations, sports tracking applications, etc.).
Pour l’heure, les Algérois sont invités: For now, the people of Algiers are invited to participate massively in this event, which combines sport, culture, and friendliness, while celebrating Algeria through its disciplines and landscapes.
